{{Quote|Lord Stryfe, the last of the patrols are returning to the ship now. There is no sign of anyone below on the planet.|Captain Meeshal|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 17">[[Legacy (2006) 17|''Legacy'' (2006) 17]]</ref>}}
A '''''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer''' was among the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in [[137 ABY]]. Commanded by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Stryfe]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Meeshal]], it was dispatched to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] to search for wayward [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of [[Joker Squad]] searched the surface and found nothing, but Stryfe nevertheless ordered a [[Destruction of Ossus Jedi Academy|planetary bombardment]].
